text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: My, thank you. You came all the way just to celebrate?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: And I brought a present too. Please try guessing it. The hint is: it’s something you like, Ai-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Something I like... could it be related to bathing?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Let’s see... handmade soap, bath bombs, or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Could it even be a shower head? Will you tell me the answer?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Actually, the other day when I went into the mountains, I found an amazing waterfall!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes. It’s not hot water so it’ll be more like a cold bath, but I think it’ll feel refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Also, I have a special Umamusume hunting license for traps and nets. Even if a wild beast appears, I can handle it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Please don’t worry. I will absolutely protect you, Ai-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. But you don’t need to protect me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No matter the opponent, I don’t lose. And I’ll gladly accept your invitation!
